Chompy squeezes toothpaste onto a brush. Chompy brushes the front teeth, then the back teeth. In the mirror, Chompy sees foam around the mouth. Chompy spits the foam into the sink and rinses the brush. The brush goes in a cup. Chompy wipes the mouth with a clean towel.

clips.text:
Chompy Shares a Peach

Chompy washes a peach for a snack. Chompy asks Muddy to cut it around the hard stone. Muddy puts the slices on a plate. Chompy gives Muddy and Pip two slices each. Chompy eats the last slice. The stone goes in the food bin. Muddy washes the knife and plate.

clips.text:
Chompy Crosses the Road

Chompy puts on a coat and walks with Muddy. They stop at a crossing by the road. A red light tells them to wait. Chompy presses the button. The walking light turns green. They check that the cars have stopped. Then they walk across together and reach the library.
